title: SMOK Strawberry Kiwi Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: Strawberry Kiwi from SMOK Nic Salts combines the sweetness of ripe strawberries with the tangy, exotic taste of kiwi. This e-liquid offers a balanced blend of fruity flavours, creating a refreshing and satisfying vape experience that’s perfect for fruit-flavour enthusiasts. SMOK Nic Salt e-liquids are designed to provide a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase nicotine e-liquids. Available in 20mg nicotine strengths, they are perfect for those looking to manage their nicotine cravings efficiently. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid ensures an optimal balance between flavour intensity and vapour production, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with vape starter kits and refillable vapes . SMOK are renowned for their innovative vaping hardware, producing some of the most iconic and influential vape kits in the world. Now they have expanded their expertise to the e-liquid market with their very own Nic Salts range. These e-liquids are conveniently packaged in 10ml bottles, offering a cost-effective, easy to carry, and environmentally friendly alternative to single-use disposable vapes. If you enjoy the tropical and vibrant taste of Kiwi Passionfruit Guava, explore the other 6 delicious flavours in the SMOK Nic Salts collection. Designed for adult smokers and vapers, this range provides a satisfying vaping experience with each puff.
